# API reference

All SDK methods use lowerCamelCase. Native Roblox APIs keep engine casing.

Types are available from the named source/Roblox module; `Types/*` is the public wire-contract namespace.
Underscore members and module constructors other than `BloxSDK.new` are private implementation details.

## Profile

Source: [src/Fields/Profile.luau](../../src/Fields/Profile.luau)

### `Profile._notify`

Notify once per changed field with immutable final values, never intermediate operations.

```luau
Profile._notify(self: Profile, old: { [string]: Core.Json }, source: "external" | "local")
```

### `Profile._overlay`

Replay pending writes over authoritative state; versions always describe only the server base.

```luau
Profile._overlay(self: Profile, base: { [string]: Core.Json }): { [string]: Core.Json }
```

### `Profile.mutate`

Apply a validated operation list atomically and optimistically, without yielding or HTTP.

```luau
Profile.mutate(self: Profile, ops: { FieldTypes.PlayerOperation }): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.add`

Buffer a numeric delta and make its optimistic value visible immediately.

```luau
Profile.add(
	self: Profile,
	field: string,
	delta: number,
	path: FieldTypes.Path?
): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.set`

Buffer a last-writer-wins replacement and make it visible immediately.

```luau
Profile.set(
	self: Profile,
	field: string,
	value: Core.Json,
	path: FieldTypes.Path?
): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.grant`

Give the player members of an item list field. Idempotent; the members must exist and be active in the list.
Needs the list's live view to have loaded (`profile:grant` fails with `enum_source_unavailable` until then);
`unknown_member`, `member_retired` and `member_limit` are refused before anything is buffered, and the server
applies the same checks authoritatively when the buffer is saved.

```luau
Profile.grant(self: Profile, field: string, members: { string }): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.revoke`

Take members away from the player. Idempotent; retired members may be taken away.

```luau
Profile.revoke(self: Profile, field: string, members: { string }): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.replace`

Make the player hold exactly these members of an item list field; an empty list clears the field.
The result is checked like `grant`, so this fails when it would gain a retired member.

```luau
Profile.replace(self: Profile, field: string, members: { string }): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.has`

Whether the player holds `member` in a bitmap field (a retired member counts while it is held).
Reads the cached list; yields only to ask the server while the list has not loaded.

```luau
Profile.has(
	self: Profile,
	field: string,
	member: string,
	opts: Core.CallOptions?
): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.members`

The member names the player holds in a bitmap field, sorted. A bit the cached list does not know yet (a
member added after its last refresh) shows as `#<bit>`.

```luau
Profile.members(self: Profile, field: string, opts: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<{ string }>
```

### `Profile.usable`

What the player can use here: the members they hold that are active in the item list, sorted. Retired
members and members this server has not seen yet are left out. Reads the cached list; while the list has
not loaded it asks the server instead (which yields).

```luau
Profile.usable(self: Profile, field: string, opts: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<{ string }>
```

### `Profile.refresh`

Fetch and validate a complete snapshot; concurrent local commits cannot be overwritten by old reads.

```luau
Profile.refresh(self: Profile, opts: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.tryGet`

Return a validated immutable value; unknown/archived ids and stale snapshots return typed errors.

```luau
Profile.tryGet(self: Profile, id: string): Core.Result<Core.Json>
```

### `Profile.get`

Synchronous getter for generated static accessors; throws only a value-free typed code on misuse.

```luau
Profile.get(self: Profile, id: string): Core.Json
```

### `Profile.apply`

Apply newer per-field versions; mutation allocation tokens never advance the snapshot watermark.

```luau
Profile.apply(self: Profile, result: Wire.Result, source: ("external" | "local")?): boolean
```

### `Profile._invalidate`

Fence older in-flight reads and require recovery to cover the last safe server cursor.

```luau
Profile._invalidate(self: Profile, floor: number?)
```

### `Profile.applyChanges`

Apply only complete server-visible ledger groups; acknowledgements never become watermarks.

```luau
Profile.applyChanges(self: Profile, page: Wire.PlayerChangesItem, since: number): boolean
```

### `Profile.immediate`

Build an owned transaction that updates this profile after acknowledgement, not before commit.

```luau
Profile.immediate(self: Profile): Transaction.Transaction
```

### `Profile.pullChanges`

Drain complete sequence groups using nextSinceSeq, then snapshot NONE-history/computed/hash-only changes.

```luau
Profile.pullChanges(self: Profile, opts: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.heartbeat`

Publish the current lease and expose session_conflict without overriding the holder.

```luau
Profile.heartbeat(self: Profile, opts: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<Wire.Presence>
```

### `Profile.startPresence`

Acquire a session, then start serial heartbeats only after successful acquisition.

```luau
Profile.startPresence(
	self: Profile,
	placeId: number,
	sessionId: string?,
	interval: number?
): Core.Result<Wire.Presence>
```

### `Profile.stopPresence`

Stop future heartbeats and release only this session; retain identity on an uncertain release.

```luau
Profile.stopPresence(self: Profile, opts: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<boolean>
```

### `Profile.close`

Release presence within the owning client's remaining shutdown deadline.

```luau
Profile.close(self: Profile, deadline: number): boolean
```

### `Profile.destroy`

Cancel background activity without issuing any new requests.

```luau
Profile.destroy(self: Profile)
```

### `Profile.release`

Release this profile and its owned presence/background registration.

```luau
Profile.release(self: Profile): boolean
```

### Exported types

```luau
export type IO = {
	document: (Core.CallOptions?) -> Core.Result<Wire.Document>,
	changes: (number, Core.CallOptions?) -> Core.Result<Wire.ChangesResponse>,
	presence: (Wire.PresenceInput, Core.CallOptions?) -> Core.Result<Wire.Presence>,
	transaction: ((Wire.Result) -> ()) -> Transaction.Transaction,
	--- The cached live view of the item list a bitmap field points at (`client.configs:namespace(source)`).
	itemList: (source: string) -> Namespace.Namespace?,
	--- Server truth: the member names this player holds in a bitmap field (used while the list has not loaded).
	members: (field: string, Core.CallOptions?) -> Core.Result<Wire.PlayerMembers>,
}

export type Profile = -- opaque handle; see methods below
```

### `Transaction.revoke`


Attach the required audit reason.


### `Transaction.ref`

Attach an optional trusted business reference.


### `Transaction.key`

Set a caller-persisted identity before commit for restart-safe workflows.

```luau
Transaction.key(self: Transaction, key: string): Transaction
```

### `Transaction.idempotencyKey`

Expose the once-generated identity so callers can persist/reconcile an uncertain outcome.

### `Transaction.validateLocal`

Validate the entire sealed transaction locally; no implicit schema fetch on invalid/unloaded builders.

```luau
	options: Core.CallOptions?

```

Seal once, validate before sending, and reuse the same key/payload after uncertain failures.


## Schema

Source: [src/Fields/Schema.luau](../../src/Fields/Schema.luau)

### `Schema.refresh`

Atomically publish a complete validated generation, keeping last-good on every failure.

```luau
Schema.refresh(self: Schema, opts: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<number>
```

### `Schema.load`

Return the cached generation, or synchronously load the first one (never discard last-good).

```luau
Schema.load(self: Schema): Core.Result<number>
```

### `Schema.definitions`

Expose immutable definitions, including archived/computed/shared metadata.

### `Schema.get`

Resolve a definition without implicitly fetching or masking unknown ids.

```luau

```

## Rotations

Source: [src/Fields/Rotations.luau](../../src/Fields/Rotations.luau)

### `Rotations.validName`

Check the published name grammar before building a route.

```luau
Rotations.validName(name: unknown): boolean
```

### `Rotations.current`

What is active now and what comes next. Cached until the period ends (at most 60 seconds), so call
it as often as you like; if a refresh fails while the cached period is still running, that answer is kept.

```luau
Rotations.current(self: Client, name: string, options: Core.CallOptions?): Core.Result<Current>
```

### `Rotations.secondsLeft`

Seconds until the active items change (display only; never negative).

```luau
Rotations.secondsLeft(self: Client, current: Current): number
```

### `Rotations.upcoming`

The next `count` periods (default 5, at most 50), starting with the active one. Not cached.

```luau
Rotations.upcoming(
	self: Client,
	name: string,
	count: number?,
	options: Core.CallOptions?
): Core.Result<{ Period }>
```

### `Rotations.watch`

Call `callback(current)` now and again whenever the active items change (a new period starts or the
list is edited). Stops with `watch:disconnect()` or when the client is destroyed.

```luau
Rotations.watch(self: Client, name: string, callback: (Current) -> ()): Watch
```

### Exported types

```luau
export type Item = { id: string, data: { [string]: any }? }

export type Period = { items: { Item }, startsAt: number, endsAt: number }

export type Current = {
	key: string,
	version: number,

}
```

```luau
	| {
		field: string,
		subject: S?,
		path: Path?,

		items: { Core.Json },
	}
	| {
		field: string,
		subject: S?,
		path: Path?,
		op: "REMOVE_AT",

	| {
		field: string,
		subject: S?,
		path: Path?,
		op: "MAP_PUT",

	}
	| {
		field: string,
		subject: S?,
		path: Path?,
		op: "MAP_REMOVE",
		keys: { string },
	}
	| {
		field: string,
		subject: S?,
		path: Path?,
		op: "MAP_ADD",
		key: string,
		delta: number,
	}
	| {
		field: string,
		subject: S?,
		path: Path?,
		op: "GRANT" | "REVOKE" | "REPLACE",
		members: { string },
	}

export type PlayerOperation = OperationShape<nil>

export type Operation = OperationShape<number>

export type Expectation = { version: number } | { equals: Core.Json } | { exists: boolean }

export type Condition =
	{ field: string, subject: number?, path: Path? }
	& ({ expectedVersion: number } | { equals: Core.Json } | { exists: boolean })

export type FilterLiteral = number | string | boolean

export type Filter =
	{ op: "AND" | "OR", clauses: { Filter } }
	| { op: "NOT", clause: Filter }
	| { op: "EQ" | "NE" | "LT" | "LE" | "GT" | "GE", field: string, value: FilterLiteral }
	| { op: "IN", field: string, value: { FilterLiteral } }
	| { op: "EXISTS", field: string, value: boolean }

export type BulkTarget =
	{ kind: "ALL" }

export type ScheduleAction =

export type Converter =
	{
		kind: "IDENTITY"
			| "CLAMP"
			| "INT_TO_NUMBER"

			| "STRING_TO_NUMBER"
			| "TO_STRING"
			| "BOOL_TO_INT"
			| "WRAP_NULLABLE"
			| "LIST_TO_SET"
			| "SET_TO_LIST",
	}
	| { kind: "NUMBER_TO_INT", rounding: "ROUND" | "FLOOR" | "CEIL" }
	| { kind: "ENUM_RENAME", map: { [string]: string } }
	| { kind: "UNWRAP_NULLABLE", fallback: Core.Json }
	| { kind: "MAP_VALUE", converter: Converter? }

export type ImportRecord =
	{ subject: number, field: string, op: "SET", value: Core.Json, universeId: number? }
	| { subject: number, field: string, op: "ADD", delta: number, universeId: number? }
```

## SnapshotCache

Source: [src/Core/SnapshotCache.luau](../../src/Core/SnapshotCache.luau)

### `Snapshot.refresh`

Fetch conditionally; errors, 304s and version regressions never discard a good snapshot.

```luau
Snapshot.refresh(self: Snapshot): boolean
```

### `Snapshot.isDestroyed`

Expose lifecycle state without requiring a polling task.

```luau
Snapshot.isDestroyed(self: Snapshot): boolean
```

### `Snapshot.isEnabled`

Return the cached master switch, not per-user rollout/rules evaluation; use fields:evaluateFlags for that.

```luau
Snapshot.isEnabled(self: Snapshot, flag: string): boolean
```

### `Snapshot.version`

Read the last successfully applied universe generation.

```luau
Snapshot.version(self: Snapshot): number?
```

### `Snapshot.destroy`

Stop polling, cancel in-flight work and disconnect all listeners.

```luau
Snapshot.destroy(self: Snapshot)
```

### Exported types

```luau
export type Connection = { disconnect: (Connection) -> () }

export type Changed = { connect: (Changed, (Types.RuntimeSnapshot) -> ()) -> Connection }

export type Snapshot = -- opaque handle; see methods below
```

## AuditWriter

Source: [src/Core/AuditWriter.luau](../../src/Core/AuditWriter.luau)

### `Writer.pending`

Count queued and in-flight events; unacknowledged events remain in the queue.

```luau
Writer.pending(self: Writer): number
```

### `Writer.enqueue`

Enqueue without yielding; return false on invalid input, closed admission or capacity exhaustion.

```luau
Writer.enqueue(self: Writer, event: Types.EventInput): boolean
```

### `Writer.flush`

Start a serialized nonblocking flush; retain a failed batch and its keys for the next flush.

```luau
Writer.flush(self: Writer)
```

### `Writer.close`

Stop queue admission and cooperatively drain within the shutdown budget; failure remains observable.

```luau
Writer.close(self: Writer, timeout: number?): boolean
```

### `Writer.destroy`

Cancel pending transport and timers; unsent queue data is not persisted by this in-memory helper.

```luau
Writer.destroy(self: Writer)
```

### Exported types

```luau
export type Options = { batchSize: number?, interval: number?, capacity: number? }

export type Writer = -- opaque handle; see methods below
```
